scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n web,admin,api -c yellow,magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w apps/web" "npm run dev -w apps/admin" "npm run dev -w apps/api"
scripts.check: npm run check -w apps/web && npm run check -w apps/admin && npm run build -w apps/api
scripts.test:integration: npm run build -w apps/api && node infra/scripts/test-cms.cjs
scripts.db:setup: npm run build -w apps/api && npm run db:migrate && npm run setup:cms
scripts.test:news: npm run build -w apps/api && node infra/scripts/test-news.cjs
